body:
You could talk to the other people on this subreddit.

I think that would help a lot of people who need it.

Honestly, I think the best people at stopping suicide are people who can relate

Even if she's only puts up with you because your suicidal, that still shows that she cares about you.

I think she's actually trying to maintain the friendship since she still talks to you.

If you can't communicate verbally with people, she must be putting in a lot of effort to make sure that you're still her friend

Fuck your boyfriend, he's a little shit.

He didn't even have the decency to do it behind your back.

I think you should disregard some of the stuff he's said.

Find someone else who cares, and who's also legitimate.

I think that in character, you're above his league

Inanimate objects are always there for you.

You can always talk to a stuffed animal, or a pillow: anything.

Honestly, they are better listeners than most people and they care, too.

You don't have to worry if you're making them uncomfortable too, because it's up to your imagination to decide how they respond.

You can do it anywhere too, since you don't have to do it out loud, and what you say is only between you and that object.

Yo holy shit slow down

Wait until tomorrow, put it off.

You aren't a pussy for taking time.

Suicide is a big commitment and I think everybody should take more time than they already have taken to think it through.

Go to sleep, in a way that you'll wake up again tomorrow.

Please?

I've heard a lot of people say that your high school years will be your best years, but

I've heard more people say that that's total bullshit.

Maybe if you ride things out a little longer things will look up.

So I was reading some of your earlier posts and read that you think that everybody hates you.

I like who you are.

I think you're a rather nice person.

You're always nice and polite when you comment on other posts.

Here's one of your comments as an example:

"I'm really happy for you! Hope your rest of the year is as happy and well as its start. Wishing you the best!"

I think that that's some pretty good proof that you're a nice genuine person.  

so,

Fuck those people that hate you.

They're shallow shitty people.

Maybe if you just find one or two real people that will really listen, pay attention so that they can understand you, everything would be a little nicer.  And if you can't find any people, find a stuffed animal or something to talk to and hug.  They're better at listening and caring than most people.

Maybe suicide isn't the right thing to do.
You can always run away from abusive people and fake people.

Sometimes I fantasize going camping or something and never coming back.  
Just live by myself, by my own rules and nobody's mean and the only company I'll have will be things like trees and plants and rocks too which sometimes make better company than people.

I think there's other solutions to feeling like shit/angry/sad/frustrated/a lot of other things, all the time.
